cast: Lily (girl, 9), her puppy Max, Mum and Dad. Max never eats chocolate, grapes, onion or garlic (toxic to dogs).

words.en: Lily eats a red apple.
words.scene: One shiny red apple with a green leaf on its stalk.
more: An apple a day is good for you.
每天一个苹果对身体好。
Lily puts an apple in her bag.
Lily 把一个苹果放进书包。

words.en: Mum and Lily bake a cake.
words.sz: 妈妈和 Lily 烤了一个蛋糕。
words.scene: Mum and Lily taking a cake out of a warm oven together, wearing oven gloves.
more: Grandma likes to bake on Saturday.
奶奶喜欢在星期六烘焙。

words.en: A banana is long and yellow.
words.scene: One long curved yellow banana.
more: Lily has a banana for breakfast.

words.en: We have a barbecue in the garden.
words.scene: A family barbecue in a sunny garden: Dad at a round barbecue grill with sausages and smoke rising.
more: Dad cooks sausages on the barbecue.
爸爸在烧烤架上烤香肠。
Let's have a barbecue on Sunday.

words.en: Max likes dog biscuits.
words.scene: Max happily holding a bone-shaped dog biscuit in his mouth.
more: Can I have a biscuit, please?
Grandma gives Lily a chocolate biscuit.
奶奶给 Lily 一块巧克力饼干。

words.en: Dad boils water for tea.
words.scene: A metal pot of water boiling on a stove, big bubbles rising and steam puffing up.
more: Boil the eggs for ten minutes.
Water starts to boil at 100 degrees.

words.en: I have a boiled egg for breakfast.
words.scene: Side view of one whole smooth white egg standing upright in a small blue egg cup, the very top of the shell cracked off to show cooked white and a runny yolk, a teaspoon beside it, plain table.
more: We have boiled rice with the fish.

words.en: Lily has a bottle of water.
words.scene: Lily holding a clear plastic bottle of water.
more: There is milk in the bottle.

words.en: Max has a blue bowl.
words.scene: Max next to his round blue dog bowl full of food.
more: Lily eats her soup from a bowl.
Put the fruit in the big bowl.

words.en: The cups are in a big box.
words.sz: 杯子装在一个大箱子里。
words.scene: One open cardboard box with a few cups packed inside.
more: The cake is in a box.
Lily opens the box of chocolates.

words.en: We buy bread every morning.
words.scene: One golden crusty loaf of bread on a wooden board.
more: I'd like some bread and butter.
Mum cuts the bread with a knife.

words.en: We eat a snack at break.
words.note: Word Atlas 的 break 是动词“打破”；食物话题取名词“休息”
words.scene: Children in a school playground at break time, chatting and eating small snacks, school building in the background.
more: The morning break is twenty minutes.
上午的课间休息是二十分钟。

words.en: Be careful! Don't break the glass.
words.scene: A white cup falling off a kitchen table and breaking into pieces on the floor, Tom looking surprised with his hands on his cheeks.
more: Please don't break my new toy.

words.en: Lily has breakfast at seven.
words.scene: Lily at the kitchen table in the morning sunshine eating breakfast: a bowl of cereal, toast, orange juice.
more: What do you have for breakfast?

words.en: Dad makes a big burger.
words.scene: One big tasty burger with a sesame bun, beef patty, cheese, lettuce and tomato.
more: Tom wants a burger and chips.
Tom 想要一个汉堡和薯条。

words.en: I put butter on my bread.
words.scene: A yellow block of butter on a small dish with a knife spreading some on a slice of bread.
more: We need butter to make a cake.
Put the butter in the fridge.

words.en: Mum and Lily meet at a cafe.
words.sz: 妈妈和 Lily 在咖啡馆见面。
words.scene: Mum and Lily sitting at a small round table outside a cosy little cafe with cups and cakes, striped awning.
more: The cafe sells cakes and coffee.
这家咖啡馆卖蛋糕和咖啡。
Let's have lunch at the cafe.
我们去咖啡馆吃午饭吧。

words.en: We have lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.sz: 我们在学校食堂吃午饭。
words.scene: Children with trays in a bright school cafeteria, a long counter with food and long tables.
more: Lily sits with her friends in the cafeteria.
Lily 和朋友们坐在食堂里。

words.en: Happy birthday! Here is your cake.
words.sz: 生日快乐！这是你的蛋糕。
words.scene: A birthday cake with pink icing and lit candles on top.
more: 奶奶做了一个巧克力蛋糕。
Can I have some more cake?

words.en: Dad opens a can of soup.
words.note: Word Atlas 的 can 是情态动词“能”；食物话题取名词“罐头”
words.scene: Side view of one plain metal tin can with a plain terracotta paper label with no writing at all, a metal can opener lying beside it, on a kitchen counter.
more: There is a can of cola in the fridge.
senses: I can ride a bike. Can I have one?

words.en: Lily can ride a bike.
words.scene: Lily riding a bicycle along a sunny park path, looking proud and happy, Max running beside her.
more: Can I have a biscuit, please?
Max can't fly, but he can run fast.
Max 不会飞，但他能跑得很快。

words.en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.
words.sz: 吃太多糖果对牙齿不好。
words.scene: A big glass jar full of colourful wrapped candies and lollipops.

words.en: Rabbits like carrots.
words.scene: One orange carrot with green leafy top, a white rabbit nibbling it.
more: The rabbit is eating a carrot.
Lily cuts a carrot for the soup.
Lily 切了一根胡萝卜做汤。

words.en: Lily eats cereal with milk.
words.scene: A bowl of crunchy cereal with milk being poured in and a spoon.
more: Put some milk on your cereal.

words.en: The mouse wants the cheese.
words.scene: A yellow wedge of cheese with holes, a tiny mouse sniffing it.
more: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.
我想要一个奶酪三明治。

words.en: The chef has a tall white hat.
words.sz: 大厨戴着一顶高高的白帽子。
words.scene: A grown-up adult chef, a jolly man with a moustache, in a tall white chef's hat and white double-breasted jacket, holding a wooden spoon by a big pot in a restaurant kitchen.
more: The chef cooks in the kitchen.
Lily wants to be a chef.

words.en: We have chicken and rice for dinner.
words.sz: 我们晚饭吃鸡肉和米饭。
more: The chicken lives on a farm.

words.en: Chillies are very hot!
words.scene: Two shiny bright red chillies, one with tiny flames drawn around it to show it is hot.
more: Don't eat the chilli! It's very hot.
Dad puts a chilli in the curry.
爸爸往咖喱里放了一个辣椒。

words.en: Can I have fish and chips, please?
words.sz: 请给我一份炸鱼薯条好吗？
words.scene: A paper cone of golden fried chips next to a piece of battered fish.
more: Tom wants chips with his burger.

words.en: Chocolate is not good for dogs, Max!
words.scene: A bar of chocolate with the foil wrapper peeled back, a few chocolate squares broken off.
more: Lily 很爱巧克力冰淇淋。
Grandma gives us a box of chocolate.
奶奶给了我们一盒巧克力。

words.en: Dad drinks coffee in the morning.
words.scene: Dad holding a white mug of hot coffee in the morning, steam rising, coffee beans beside it.

words.en: Lily drinks cola at the party.
words.scene: A glass of fizzy brown cola with ice cubes, bubbles and a straw.
more: Too much cola is bad for your teeth.
喝太多可乐对牙齿不好。

words.en: Dad likes to cook on Sundays.
words.sz: 爸爸喜欢在星期天做饭。
words.scene: Dad cooking at the stove, stirring a pan with a wooden spoon, wearing an apron.
more: Grandma is a very good cook.

words.en: Don't put your hand on the cooker. It's hot!
words.sz: 别把手放在炉灶上，很烫！
words.scene: A kitchen cooker with an oven door and four rings on top, one ring glowing red hot with a pot on it.
more: We have a new cooker in the kitchen.
我们厨房里有个新炉灶。
The soup is on the cooker.

words.en: I like strawberries and cream.
words.scene: A bowl of fresh red strawberries topped with a big swirl of white whipped cream.
more: Would you like cream on your cake?
Lily puts cream in her coffee.

words.en: Would you like a cup of tea?
words.scene: One cup and saucer of tea with a little steam rising.
more: Grandma has a cup of tea.

words.en: Mum makes chicken curry.
words.scene: A bowl of yellow chicken curry next to a plate of white rice.
more: We have curry and rice on Friday.

words.en: Dad cuts the pizza.
words.scene: Dad cutting a pizza into slices with a pizza cutter.
more: Mum, can you cut my meat, please?
Cut the cake into eight pieces.

words.en: This soup is delicious!
words.scene: Lily tasting soup from a spoon with her eyes closed and a big happy smile, little hearts around her.

words.en: What's for dessert?
words.note: 插画是服务员上菜，看不出甜点
words.scene: Side view of a small glass bowl of wobbly red fruit jelly topped with whipped cream and a cherry, a little dessert spoon beside it.
more: We have ice cream for dessert.

words.en: We have dinner at six.
words.scene: Mum, Dad and Lily sitting together at the dining table in the evening eating dinner, warm lamp light, dark blue night sky and moon in the window.

words.en: Pizza is my favourite dish.
words.note: 插画是一碗草莓，易误认为“草莓”
words.scene: A steaming home-cooked stew in a round terracotta serving dish placed in the middle of a family dinner table.
more: Put the dish on the table.

words.en: Max drinks lots of water.
words.scene: Max drinking water from a bowl, water drops splashing.
more: Can I have a drink, please?
Lily likes to drink orange juice.

words.en: Let's eat!
words.scene: Lily happily eating a big plate of pasta with a fork.
more: What do you want to eat?
Max wants to eat my sandwich!

words.en: The chicken has an egg.
words.scene: A brown hen sitting in a straw nest next to one smooth white egg.
more: I'd like a boiled egg, please.
We need one egg for the cake.

words.en: We have fish for lunch today.
more: A fish can swim but it can't walk.

words.en: Max loves his food.
words.scene: Max sitting excitedly in front of a full bowl of dog food, tongue out.
more: 比萨是我最爱吃的食物。
We buy food at the supermarket.

words.en: Eat your pasta with a fork.
words.scene: One shiny silver fork with a little twirl of spaghetti on it.
more: Put the fork next to the plate.
Tom eats his chips with a fork.

words.en: The milk is in the fridge.
words.scene: An open fridge full of food, a bottle of milk on the door shelf, cold light inside.
more: Put the butter in the fridge.
There is cola in the fridge.

words.en: I like fried eggs.
words.scene: One fried egg with a round yellow yolk sizzling in a black frying pan.
more: Fried food is not very healthy.

words.en: Fruit is good for you.
words.scene: A big basket full of mixed fruit: apples, bananas, grapes, oranges and pears.
more: Which fruit do you like best?

words.en: Garlic is good in pasta sauce.
words.sz: 大蒜放在意面酱里很好吃。
words.scene: One whole bulb of white garlic and a few garlic cloves.
more: Mum puts garlic in the pasta sauce.
妈妈在意面酱里放了大蒜。

words.en: Lily drinks a glass of milk.
words.note: 插画是一块玻璃板，不是玻璃杯
words.scene: Side view of one tall clear drinking glass filled to the top with white milk, standing alone on a wooden table, plain background.
more: Can I have a glass of water?
Be careful! The glass is full.

words.en: These grapes are green and sweet.
words.sz: 这些葡萄是绿色的，很甜。
words.scene: One bunch of green grapes.
more: Dogs can't eat a single grape.

words.en: Dad likes grilled fish.
words.scene: Fish with dark grill marks cooking on a metal grill pan, lemon slices beside it.

words.en: Bees make honey.
words.scene: A jar of golden honey with a wooden honey dipper dripping honey, a bee flying nearby.
more: Lily puts honey on her toast.

words.en: I'm hungry. Can I have a snack?
words.sz: 我饿了。我能吃点零食吗？
words.scene: Lily holding her tummy with a sad hungry face looking at an empty plate, a growling tummy.
more: Are you hungry? Dinner is ready.

words.en: Put some ice in my juice, please.
words.sz: 请在我的果汁里加点冰。
words.scene: A glass of orange juice with clear ice cubes dropping in and splashing.
more: There is ice on the lake.
Can I have some ice in my cola?

words.en: Lily wants a strawberry ice cream.
words.sz: Lily 想要一个草莓冰淇淋。
words.scene: A girl holding a pink strawberry ice cream cone on a sunny day at the seaside.
more: Tom wants a chocolate ice cream.
Tom 想要一个巧克力冰淇淋。
We eat ice cream on hot days.

words.en: I like bread and jam.
words.scene: A slice of bread spread with red strawberry jam next to a jar of jam.
more: Put some jam on your bread.

words.en: Can I have orange juice?
words.scene: A tall glass of orange juice next to half an orange.
more: Lily drinks a glass of juice.

words.en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.
words.scene: A bright cosy family kitchen with cupboards, a sink, a cooker and Mum cooking.
more: The kitchen is next to the dining room.
Dad is washing the plates in the kitchen.

words.en: Be careful with the knife!
words.scene: One table knife with a silver blade and a handle on a wooden cutting board.
more: Dad cuts the bread with a knife.
Put the knife next to the fork.

words.en: A lemon is yellow.
words.scene: One bright yellow lemon and one half lemon showing its juicy inside.
more: Put some lemon on the fish.

words.en: We drink lemonade in summer.
words.scene: A tall jug of cloudy lemonade with lemon slices and ice, two filled glasses beside it, summer garden table.
more: Lily 和妈妈一起做柠檬水。

words.en: What's for lunch today?
words.scene: Lily eating a sandwich lunch at midday, bright noon sun high in the sky, a lunch box open on the table.
more: We have lunch at twelve o'clock.
Lily takes her lunch to school.

words.en: For the main course, I want pasta.
words.scene: A dinner plate with grilled fish, rice and green vegetables, a knife and fork on either side, restaurant table.
more: The main course is chicken and rice.
What would you like for your main course?

words.en: Breakfast is the first meal of the day.
words.sz: 早餐是一天的第一顿饭。
words.scene: Mum, Dad and Lily sitting around a family table with a complete meal: a big main dish, a bowl of vegetables, bread and drinks, a plate in front of each person.
more: 晚饭是我最喜欢的一顿饭。
We have a big meal on Sunday.
我们星期天吃一顿大餐。

words.en: Max loves meat.
words.scene: Max looking hungrily at a big piece of raw red meat on a butcher's wooden board.
more: The meat is on the barbecue.

words.en: This melon is very sweet.
words.scene: One green melon cut open showing sweet orange flesh and a slice cut out.
more: This melon is big and sweet.

words.en: Can we see the menu, please?
words.sz: 请给我们看看菜单好吗？
words.scene: Close-up of a big open restaurant menu booklet lying on a table, both pages filled with large colourful drawings of food in neat rows: pizza, burger, salad, soup and ice cream, no writing.
more: The menu has lots of dishes.

words.en: Cows give us milk.
words.scene: A glass of white milk next to a glass milk bottle, a cow in a field far behind.
more: Lily drinks a glass of milk.
We need milk for the cake.

words.en: A bottle of mineral water, please.
words.scene: Side view of one clear plastic bottle of clear sparkling water full of bubbles, blue cap, plain blue label with no writing, a clear glass of water beside it, snowy mountains far behind.
more: I'd like some mineral water, please.
Mineral water is good for you.

words.en: There are mushrooms on my pizza.
words.scene: Two brown mushrooms with round caps.
more: There is a mushroom in the forest.

words.en: Dad cooks with a little oil.
words.note: Word Atlas 的 oil 插画是石油；食物话题取食用油
words.scene: Close-up side view: a hand tilting a glass bottle and pouring a thin stream of golden yellow cooking oil into a black frying pan.
more: Put some oil on the salad.
We need oil to make chips.

words.en: Dad makes an omelette with cheese.
words.sz: 爸爸做了一个奶酪煎蛋饼。
words.scene: A folded yellow omelette with melted cheese oozing out, in a frying pan.
more: An omelette is made with eggs.
Lily has an omelette for lunch.

words.en: Onions make me cry!
words.scene: One brown onion and one half onion showing its rings, Lily crying a little from cutting it.
more: Mum cuts an onion for the soup.
妈妈切了一个洋葱做汤。

words.en: An orange is round.
words.scene: One round orange fruit with a green leaf.
more: Lily eats an orange after lunch.
Lily 午饭后吃了一个橙子。

words.en: We have pasta on Fridays.
words.sz: 我们每周五吃意大利面。
words.scene: A plate of spaghetti pasta with red tomato sauce and basil.
more: Tom 很爱吃加奶酪的意面。

words.en: Lily gives Dad a pear.
words.scene: Lily handing a green pear to Dad.
more: A pear is green or yellow.

words.en: Can you pass the salt and pepper?
words.sz: 你能把盐和胡椒递过来吗？
words.scene: A wooden pepper mill grinding black pepper next to a white salt shaker, with a red bell pepper and a green bell pepper beside them.
more: Put some salt and pepper on the meat.
Dad likes black pepper on his eggs.
爸爸喜欢在鸡蛋上撒黑胡椒。

words.en: Let's have a picnic in the park!
words.scene: A family picnic on a checked blanket in a sunny park with a picnic basket, sandwiches and fruit.
more: We have a picnic by the lake.
Lily takes sandwiches to the picnic.

words.en: Lily wants pizza for dinner.
words.scene: One whole round pizza with tomato, melted cheese and mushrooms.
more: This pizza has cheese and mushrooms on it.
这个比萨上有奶酪和蘑菇。

words.en: Put the cake on a plate.
words.scene: One empty round white dinner plate.
more: Lily puts the cake on her plate.
Lily 把蛋糕放在盘子上。
Can I have a clean plate, please?
能给我一个干净的盘子吗？

words.en: Chips are made from potatoes.
words.scene: A few brown potatoes, one cut in half showing pale yellow inside.
more: Dad puts a potato in the soup.
爸爸往汤里放了一个土豆。
Would you like a baked potato?

words.en: I eat rice every day.
words.scene: A bowl full of fluffy white rice with chopsticks.
more: We have fish and rice for dinner.
Can I have some more rice?

words.en: We have roast chicken on Sunday.
words.scene: A golden roast chicken on a serving tray with roast potatoes, fresh out of the oven.
more: Grandma makes roast chicken on Sunday.

words.en: Mum makes a green salad.
words.sz: 妈妈做了一份蔬菜沙拉。
words.scene: A big bowl of green salad with lettuce, tomatoes and cucumber.
more: A salad is good for you.
Lily 做了一份水果沙拉。

words.en: The sea water has salt in it.
words.scene: A white salt shaker with a little salt spilling out.
more: Don't put too much salt on your chips.
Can you pass the salt, please?

words.en: Lily takes a sandwich to school.
words.scene: One sandwich cut into two triangles showing cheese, tomato and lettuce inside.
more: 我想要一个奶酪三明治。
Tom eats his sandwich in the park.

words.en: I want tomato sauce on my chips.
words.scene: A bottle of red tomato sauce squeezing sauce onto golden chips.
more: Do you want sauce on your burger?

words.en: Max wants my sausage!
words.scene: Max looking up hopefully at one sausage on a fork.
more: Dad cooks a sausage on the barbecue.
爸爸在烧烤架上烤香肠。
Tom has a sausage for breakfast.
Tom 早餐吃了一根香肠。

words.en: Can I have a slice of pizza?
words.scene: A pizza with one triangle slice pulled away with stretchy cheese.
more: Lily has a slice of bread.
Would you like a slice of cake?

words.en: An apple is a good snack.
words.scene: Lily munching a red apple as a snack on the way home from school, with her school bag.
more: Tom has a snack after school.
A banana is a healthy snack.

words.en: Hot soup is nice on cold days.
words.scene: A steaming bowl of orange tomato soup with a spoon on a cold snowy day, snow outside the window.
more: Eat your soup before it gets cold.

words.en: Dad cooks a steak for dinner.
words.sz: 爸爸晚饭煎了一块牛排。
words.scene: One thick cooked brown beef steak with dark criss-cross grill marks, sizzling hot with steam, on a white plate with a few chips and green beans.
more: Dad likes his steak with chips.
爸爸吃牛排喜欢配薯条。

words.en: Strawberries are red and sweet.
words.scene: Three bright red strawberries with green tops.
more: Lily finds a big strawberry in the garden.
Lily 在花园里找到一颗大草莓。
I'd like a strawberry ice cream.
我想要一个草莓冰淇淋。

words.en: No sugar in my tea, thanks.
words.scene: A bowl of white sugar cubes, one sugar cube in tongs.
more: Do you take sugar in your tea?
We need sugar to make a cake.

words.en: Honey is very sweet.
words.scene: A pile of colourful wrapped sweets and a lollipop.
more: Can I have a sweet, please?

words.en: Grandma likes a cup of tea.
words.scene: A grandmother with grey hair and glasses smiling, holding a cup of tea with a teapot beside her.
more: Would you like a cup of tea?

words.en: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water?
words.scene: Lily under a blazing hot summer sun, red face, sweat drops, tongue out panting, eagerly gulping a big glass of cold water.
more: Max is thirsty after the walk.
Are you thirsty? Have some water.

words.en: I have toast and jam for breakfast.
words.scene: Two slices of golden toast popping up out of a toaster.
more: Lily puts butter on her toast.

words.en: A tomato is red and round.
words.scene: One round shiny red tomato with a green stalk.
more: Lily puts a tomato in the salad.
Lily 在沙拉里放了一个西红柿。

words.en: Eat your vegetables, Lily!
words.scene: A wooden crate full of mixed fresh vegetables: carrots, broccoli, tomatoes, peppers and potatoes.
more: 你最喜欢的蔬菜是什么？

words.en: The waiter brings our food.
words.scene: A smiling waiter man in a white shirt and black waistcoat carrying a tray of food to a table.
more: The waiter gives us the menu.
Tom's dad is a waiter in a cafe.
Tom 的爸爸是咖啡馆的服务员。

words.en: The waitress gives us the menu.
words.sz: 女服务员给了我们菜单。
words.scene: A smiling young waitress woman in an apron handing a menu to a family at a restaurant table.
more: 女服务员端来了我们的饮料。
Excuse me, waitress! Can we have the bill?
服务员，我们可以买单吗？

words.en: Lily helps Dad wash up after dinner.
words.sz: 晚饭后 Lily 帮爸爸洗碗。
words.scene: A girl and her father standing at a kitchen sink washing up plates with soap bubbles, a dish rack beside them.
more: Can you help me wash up?
Tom doesn't like to wash up.

words.en: I have yogurt with fruit.
words.scene: A small bowl of white yogurt topped with berries and banana slices.
